component.name: Mistcoat
component.summary: Protect artwork from AI training and style mimicry

description.p: Mistcoat makes small, mostly invisible changes to an image that degrade its value as AI training data and confuse models about what it shows, and embeds the standard machine-readable "do not train" declaration.
Everything runs on your computer. No image is ever uploaded. A preview shows exactly how much the picture changed and how much of the protection survives the re-compression upload sites apply.
No tool can make an image impossible to train on; Mistcoat raises the cost and spoils the result. Keep your unprotected originals.
